remarks: Welcome to this bright and updated one bedroom, 1.5-bath apartment at 7 Willowbrook Place in The Cove - one of Stamford's most desirable coastal neighborhoods. This charming first-floor residence offers a comfortable layout with hardwood floors throughout the living room, dining room, office, kitchen and bedroom. Other features include in-unit washer/dryer, gas range, dishwasher, private entrance from your off street parking spot, and plenty of natural light. Commuters will appreciate the close access to public transportation - the Stamford Transportation Center, serviced by Metro-North Railroad's New Haven Line, Amtrak and multiple CTtransit bus routes connects you throughout Connecticut and into NYC in under an hour. Local CTtransit buses also serve the Cove area, making it convenient to get around without a car if desired.Cummings Park and Cove Beach are also within easy reach for beach days, fishing, boardwalk strolls and family picnics. Dining, shopping and entertainment are just minutes away.
